Commercial LPG Cylinder Prices Increased Ahead of Diwali

Commercial LPG cylinder prices were increased by Rs 62.50 per 19-kg cylinder, effective October 1. Additionally, Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF) prices were hiked by approximately Rs 16 per litre. The price increase for commercial LPG cylinders occurred shortly before Diwali.
